laws.rule: Alexandria National Museum: Mobile-phone photography is allowed free of charge; commercial photography/video needs the competent authority's permission. No flash or tripods/monopods except permitted commercial use. Do not touch exhibits/showcases. Food and drinks are excluded from galleries except small water bottles. Bags/luggage larger than 40 by 40 cm are excluded from galleries and directed to the cloakroom. Follow posted instructions; this is the museum's visitor policy, not a governorate-wide photography or luggage rule.

No flash or tripods/monopods except permitted commercial use.
